lines.text: Some say the world will end in fire,
lines.meaning: Some people believe the world will be destroyed by *fire* — here, a symbol of desire and greed.
Others believe it will end in *ice* — a symbol of hatred and coldness.

lines.text: From what I’ve tasted of desire
lines.meaning: The poet says that, from his own experience of desire,

lines.text: I hold with those who favour fire.
lines.meaning: he agrees with those who think fire — desire — will end the world.
